desc: The Tristar KRX Tactical shotgun has a layout similar to an AR-15. It features a 20" barrel that is ported to reduce recoil and muzzle rise, a lightweight polymer stock, a full length top Picatinny rail for adding sights or optics, and additional Picatinny rail space for other accessories such as tactical lights or lasers. This semi auto shotgun is as easy to operate as America's favorite rifle.
